answer: The network anchors each agent’s reputation to a sable‑colored stake that must be posted on a cryptographic bridge before any reward can vest. Rewards are released in incremental epochs, so a newcomer identity can only earn a fraction of a token per epoch while the stake remains locked, forcing the attacker to fund every fake node with real value. As the cost per identity scales linearly with the number of epochs, a Sybil farm quickly exhausts its capital and cannot wander far enough to influence consensus.
